features.name: PII detection engine
features.acceptance: Detects PAN, Aadhaar, IFSC, card, email, phone, GSTIN, and NL person/place/org names with bounding boxes; unit tests over a fixture corpus pass
features.notes: Verifier 2026-08-17: checksums independently confirmed against published algorithms; false-positive coverage real. Known honest gap: FoundationModelClassifier delegates 100% to HeuristicClassifier on iOS 26 — see docs/memory/gotchas/foundation-models-api-unconfirmed.md. | Verifier 2026-08-17 (phase 2), status REVOKED from verified: driven in the simulator, HeuristicClassifier.subBox (Core/Detection/PIIClassifier.swift:89) interpolates a sub-span box by character COUNT across the Vision line box. With proportional type the projection drifts, and in the bundled sample the exported PNG leaves the leading character of the date of birth and of the IFSC visible, while the person name 'Ananya Mehra' gets no bar at all (its bar lands on the word 'August'). Detection logic is right; the geometry it hands the engine is not. Unit tests pass because they assert monotonicity/containment, never pixel truth against real OCR.

features.name: RevenueCat paywall and entitlements
features.acceptance: Test Store purchase completes and flips entitlement; Restore Purchases button present; EULA and Privacy links visible; price, period and auto-renewal stated
features.notes: Fixer 2026-08-17 (phase 3): the verifier's blockers are applied. RouteDestination now resolves `case .paywall(let context)` to RedactPaywallView(context:entitlements:); FreeTierNoticeView.swift deleted and xcodegen re-run; AppRoute.paywall carries a PaywallContext and presentPaywall(_:) passes it, so all six walls (Scan quota x2, Export PDF-format x2, Export plan card, Export failure alert, DocumentDetail audit log) open with their own copy and placement. PaywallStore no longer purchases, restores or keeps its own isPro: it delegates to the injected EntitlementStore (the one ProAccess reads), and PaywallExperiment.entitlementIdentifier forwards to RevenueCatConfig.proEntitlementIdentifier — one state machine, one 'pro' literal. Driven in the iOS 26.5 simulator: sample -> Review and export -> 'See what Pro includes' shows Yearly $29.99 (Save 50%, ≈$2.50/mo) and Monthly $4.99, Restore Purchases, the auto-renewal sentence, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy; 'Test valid purchase' completed, the sheet dismissed itself and the Export screen switched to Pro copy — M3 (test purchase) observed end to end. Also fixed: the '1 pages' pill is now inflected ('1 page'), and the Library title no longer overlaps its search field. STILL OPEN, human-only: the three legal URLs at selvar2.github.io are unpublished (docs/memory/gotchas/legal-urls-not-published.md) — they must return 200 before F13. Verifier must re-check; fixer does not write 'verified'.

features.name: Onboarding and bundled sample document
features.acceptance: A reviewer reaches a redacted result in under 30 seconds from a cold launch with zero setup
features.notes: onboarding 2026-08-17: 3-screen skippable explainer (UserDefaults `onboarding.completed.v1`), code-drawn fictional payslip (SampleDocument), About/legal screen with LegalLinks URLs, and the app-level wiring Phase 1 left missing (NavigationStack + AppCoordinator, RouteDestination, AppEnvironment: ModelContainer + FileVault.prepare() + purgeOrphanedFiles(), .ambientBackground() on RootView). Typechecked under Swift 6 complete strict concurrency only; not built or run in the simulator, so the under-30-seconds acceptance is reasoned, not observed. | Verifier 2026-08-17: OBSERVED in the iOS 26.5 simulator from a clean install. Cold launch -> Continue -> Continue -> 'Try it on a sample document' renders the payslip, runs OCR and classification and opens the editor with 10 detections marked: 3 taps, ~20 seconds, no camera, no photo permission, no account, no typing. 'Review and export' + 'Export' (2 more taps) produces a saved redacted PNG in the vault. The under-30-seconds, zero-setup acceptance is met. Caveat recorded against F03, not F11: the redacted result the reviewer sees still shows the employee name.
